description: A feature condition still evaluates and reports runtime errors when the caller already enables its feature (engine §13).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%features f
%conditions $.value.split($.tokens-after-first.value) = ∅
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text f? A
```
